Helicopter Safety
services.desc: Our helicopter of choice is a Robinson R-44 Raven I. It’s unmatched reliability, speed, and exceptional visibility from all seats made using the R-44 the clear choice. We have added several options to ensure the highest level of safety. The aircraft has a bright viper red paint scheme for exceptional visibility to other aircraft. A pulsating LED landing light system was also added. We use Traffic Information System (TIS) equipment, a system that displays air traffic on a moving GPS map to the pilot, just like an air traffic control radar display. services.name: Our Charters
services.desc: Birds Eye View Helicopter Charters offers private, luxury helicopter travel throughout New England. Skip the traffic and arrive in style with seamless, on-demand service designed around your schedule. Our most popular destinations include Montauk, Martha’s Vineyard, Nantucket, and Boston - connecting you quickly and comfortably to the region’s most sought-after coastal escapes and city hubs. Whether you’re traveling for business, a weekend getaway, or a special occasion, Birds Eye View delivers a safe, efficient, and unforgettable flight experience - because the journey should be just as exceptional as the destination. blurb: Guests can book private helicopter charters from Newport Airport to destinations such as Martha's Vineyard, Montauk, Boston Logan Airport, and New York City. Packages also include combined experiences with local attractions like the Newport Car Museum and The Breakers Mansion. Flights range from 20 minutes to 75 minutes depending on the destination.
